definitions.type: (K, p), 1 <= p <= K: equation w^(K) = Phi(w, ..., w^(K-1)) in which every monomial of Phi has weight n*p + J <= p + K (n = degree, J = number of derivatives); core = monomials of weight exactly p + K, i.e. (n - 1)*p + J = K; lower terms = the others

subtypes.slice (c): core = monomials of one degree n with J = K - (n - 1)*p >= 2
subtypes.mixed (d): core monomials of two or more degrees (the generic member has the full core)

definitions.generic member: all core and all lower monomials of degree <= 5 with independent coefficients: symbols c1.. (core), a1.. (lower); the numeric member has random rationals
definitions.every member: statements that hold for every equation of the sub-type (core coefficients nonzero, any lower terms of the type, including none)
